# pdf-lib

Vendored ES module from `pdf-lib@1.17.1`, renamed from `dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js`.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdf-lib/-/pdf-lib-1.17.1.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
License: MIT (LICENSE.md).

Loaded locally only when exporting an annotated PDF. No CDN or network is used.
